DF-POLLING.NAME: Background Polling Cycle
DF-POLLING.step-2: Requests Settings and Users from M-DB
DF-POLLING.step-4: Compares result with existing Games in M-DB. Identifies new appIds.
DF-POLLING.step-5: For each new appId, calls M-STEAM.getAppDetails()
DF-POLLING.step-7: Calls M-TG.sendMessage() to dispatch to Telegram
DF-POLLING.step-8: Saves new Games and History record to M-DB

DF-WATCHLIST.NAME: Discount Watchlist Cycle
DF-WATCHLIST.step-4: Saves PriceHistory and compares discount transition
DF-WATCHLIST.step-5: Sends Telegram alert when discount appears

DF-FREEPROMOS.NAME: Free-To-Keep Promotion Cycle
DF-FREEPROMOS.step-2: Reads settings and configured regions from M-DB
DF-FREEPROMOS.step-3: Searches Steam Store discounted-free game rows for RU/KZ
DF-FREEPROMOS.step-4: Validates each app through appdetails package data
DF-FREEPROMOS.step-5: Skips DLC, free weekends, already-sent promotion keys, and games owned by all users
DF-FREEPROMOS.step-6: Sends Telegram promotion alert with Steam, SteamDB, and ProtonDB links
DF-FREEPROMOS.step-7: Records sent appId and promotionKey for dedupe

DF-ACHIEVEMENTS.NAME: Perfect Achievement Cycle
DF-ACHIEVEMENTS.step-2: Reads settings and monitored users from M-DB
DF-ACHIEVEMENTS.step-3: Fetches owned games and recently played games for playtime comparison
DF-ACHIEVEMENTS.step-4: Selects per-app achievement candidates from changed owned/recent playtime, missing baselines, or stale progress states
DF-ACHIEVEMENTS.step-5: Fetches achievement progress only for selected candidate apps
DF-ACHIEVEMENTS.step-6: Builds a normalized snapshot with global rarity and optional SteamHunters stats when a transition must be announced
DF-ACHIEVEMENTS.step-7: Updates achievement progress baseline and stored game playtime for each checked candidate
DF-ACHIEVEMENTS.step-8: Sends a sunflower alert only when an existing non-current state transitions to a new completion key
DF-ACHIEVEMENTS.step-9: Records sent completion keys for dedupe

Phase-1.name: Database Foundation
Phase-1.step-1: Init Prisma, create schema (SQLite), generate client

Phase-3.name: Core Logic & Polling
Phase-3.step-1: Implement core diffing and formatting logic

Phase-5.name: Free-To-Keep Promotions
Phase-5.step-1: Add Steam Store Search parser for 100% discounted game candidates
Phase-5.step-2: Add promotion validation, message formatting, dedupe, and ownership filtering
Phase-5.step-3: Schedule daytime free-promotion checks from Settings
Phase-5.step-4: Expose library, watchlist, and free-promotion controls

Phase-6.name: Perfect Achievements
Phase-6.step-2: Add snapshot building, transition detection, dedupe, and Telegram formatting
Phase-6.step-3: Schedule daytime perfect-achievement checks from Settings
Phase-6.step-4: Expose achievement monitoring controls and manual latest sunflower test
Phase-6.step-5: Optimize scheduled scans with stored playtime diffs, recently played fallback, and configurable full-scan window
